name: Ärendehanteraren – Felanmälan & Feedback
author: gabrielfrattini

sections.description:
Ärendehanteraren – Felanmälan & Feedback allows you to easily integrate Ärendehanteraren’s powerful form widget into your WordPress website. Perfect for organizations that want to provide an easy way for users to report issues, give feedback, or submit support requests.

Key Features:

  • Easy-to-use shortcode integration
  • Two display modes: floating overlay or embedded inline
  • Admin-friendly settings page
  • Global widget deployment option
  • Multilingual support
  • Theme customization options
  • Clean, secure code following WordPress standards

Display Modes:

  • Floating Mode: Widget appears as an overlay button on your site
  • Embedded Mode: Widget appears inline within your page content

Usage

Basic Shortcode:
[arendehanteraren_widget form_id=”YOUR-FORM-ID”]

Embedded Mode:
[arendehanteraren_widget form_id=”YOUR-FORM-ID” mode=”embedded” container_id=”my-form-container”]

With Language and Theme:
[arendehanteraren_widget form_id=”YOUR-FORM-ID” lang=”sv” theme=”dark”]

Available Shortcode Attributes:

  • form_id (required) – Your unique form ID from Ärendehanteraren
  • mode – Display mode: “floating” (default) or “embedded”
  • container_id – Container ID for embedded mode (default: “form-widget-embedded”)
  • src – Custom script URL (optional)
  • lang – Language code (optional, e.g., “sv”, “en”)
  • theme – Theme name (optional)

Global Deployment:

Enable “Global Display” in settings to show the floating widget on all pages without using shortcodes.

Security

This plugin follows WordPress security best practices:
* All user inputs are sanitized
* All outputs are properly escaped
* Nonce verification for all forms
* Capability checks for admin functions
* No direct file access allowed

Support

For support with this plugin, please contact Ärendehanteraren support. For technical issues related to the WordPress integration, please use the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
IMPORTANT: Before installing this plugin, you need to:

  1. Visit https://app.arendehanteraren.com and create an account
  2. Create a new form in your Ärendehanteraren dashboard
  3. Copy the unique Form ID that gets generated for your form

After you have your Form ID:

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/arendehanteraren-widget/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Ärendehanteraren to configure your widget.
  4. Enter your Form ID from Ärendehanteraren (obtained from step 3 above).
  5. Choose your display settings and save.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Form ID?

To get your Form ID:

  1. Go to https://app.arendehanteraren.com and log in to your account
  2. If you don’t have an account yet, create one first
  3. Create a new form or select an existing form from your dashboard
  4. Your unique Form ID will be displayed in the form settings or can be copied from the form’s URL
  5. Copy this Form ID and paste it into the WordPress plugin settings

If you need assistance locating your Form ID, contact Ärendehanteraren support.

Can I customize the appearance of the widget?

Yes, you can use the theme attribute to apply different themes. Contact Ärendehanteraren for available theme options.

Can I use different languages?

Yes, use the lang attribute with appropriate language codes (e.g., “sv” for Swedish, “en” for English).

What’s the difference between floating and embedded mode?

Floating mode displays the widget as an overlay button, while embedded mode displays it inline within your page content where you place the shortcode.

Can I display the widget on all pages automatically?

Yes, enable “Global Display” in the settings page to show the floating widget on all front-end pages.
sections.changelog:
0.1.3

  • Fix: Properly enqueue admin notice dismissal script using wp_add_inline_script() with jQuery dependency
  • Security: Sanitize nonce input with sanitize_text_field() and wp_unslash() per WP.org security requirements
  • Fix: Rename main plugin file to match slug convention (arendehanteraren-felanmalan-feedback.php)
  • Fix: Use English strings in admin menu registration (translations provided via i18n)
  • Compliance: All scripts now properly enqueued using WordPress enqueue system

0.1.2

  • Fix: Removed discouraged load_plugin_textdomain() per WP.org Plugin Check (translations now loaded automatically by WordPress.org)

0.1.1

  • Security: Escaped all outputs for proper security compliance
  • Security: Introduced 4+ character prefix (ahff_/AHFF_) for all internal names
  • Security: Enhanced nonce verification and capability checks
  • Fix: Removed WP.org directory assets (banner/icon) from plugin package
  • Fix: Shortcode now properly registers on init for reliable operation
  • Improvement: All translations now use proper escaping functions
  • Improvement: Clean uninstall removes all plugin data
  • Hardening: Added input validation and sanitization throughout

0.1.0

  • Initial release
  • Basic shortcode functionality
  • Elementor widget support
